methodologyFindings.finding: The generated side is populated from a newly created temporary pickle, and the released side is populated from the separately pinned released pickle. Both parsers read each row's cooperators[].agent_id. The generated and released pickle SHA-256 and payload SHA-256 values differ, and no released-row object is passed into createGeneratedCooperatorManifest.
methodologyFindings.boundary: The preflight directly reparses the released pickle but consumes the exact-hash-pinned v7 generated-record certificate. It does not itself retain or reparse the deleted generated pickle.

methodologyFindings.topic: 90-row event, ego, cooperator, sort, and uniqueness semantics
methodologyFindings.finding: Both sources yield the same 90 canonical vehicle-ego records over 30 physical events. Keys are unique and sorted; each ego 1, 2, and 3 contributes 30 rows; every cooperator list is sorted and unique, excludes the ego, and equals the other three canonical agents.
The full released population cannot pass the current generator gate. The failure is exactly 30 released-only ego-0 rows, one for each physical event, with no generator-only row.

Raw equality fails only at dataset: released OPV2V versus generated CooperScene. Each derivation requires exact equality with its complete pinned raw metainfo object before returning the common canonical object, so additional classes, categories, info version, cooperative flag, or either dataset-label mutation fails rather than being hidden by the alias.
methodologyFindings.counterexampleResult: Mutating classes on either side produced METAINFO_SOURCE_MISMATCH even after recomputing the generated certificate's internal content hash.

methodologyFindings.finding: The current path byte-pins the v4 lineage artifact, v7 generated certificate, and released pickle; binds central inventory, archive prefix, released index, generated pickle, payload, fixed commit, runner, and test identities; and reproduced byte-identically. The fixed source checkout was at the claimed commit and clean during this audit.
methodologyFindings.boundary: The v5 execution is not a content-addressed official environment: numpy and PyYAML paths and versions are recorded but their package bytes are not bound, the archive-prefix SHA-256 is inherited rather than recomputed in v5, and no container digest is present. The 120 YAML members actually used are independently checked by local name, size, decompression, and CRC32.

methodologyFindings.topic: restricted pickle and stub or shim boundary
methodologyFindings.finding: Both supplied pickles pass opcode pre-screening, deny-all class lookup, and plain-value validation. The converter executes with recorded minimal mmengine and tqdm shims and open-event instrumentation. It reads 120 real CRC-checked YAML files and opens no PCD or PNG stub for reading; the 120 PCD and 90 PNG files are zero-byte existence stubs.
methodologyFindings.boundary: This is not a general safe-pickle sandbox, official dependency reproduction, point or image read, annotation audit, or --convert-pcd execution.

methodologyFindings.finding: The persisted controls exercise cooperator drop, add, swap, released-side mutation, key drop, key injection, duplicate key, hash, commit, binding, metainfo labels, full-population failure, and same-object one-sided use. They do not persist cooperator-duplicate or ego-in-cohort controls. Order permutation is a declared canonicalization invariance and should be a positive metamorphic control, not a failing negative control.
methodologyFindings.selfConfirmationRisk: The one-sided-projection control proves only that the same released object cannot occupy both expected roles. A clone with identical released records and bindings, role changed to generator, and arbitrary distinct provenance strings passes runMandatoryGate.

methodologyFindings.finding: Both certificate hashes cover every serialized certificate field, including generatedAt, commands, paths, controls, witnesses, and conclusions, except certificateSha256 itself. A generatedAt mutation without rehashing fails CERTIFICATE_HASH_MISMATCH. No mutable evidence field is silently excluded.
methodologyFindings.boundary: A self-computed hash is not a signature or trust anchor. Anyone able to rewrite a certificate can recompute its hash unless an external expected file hash is enforced. The preflight does externally pin the exact v7 generator certificate bytes; the final v7 preflight certificate has no official signature.

methodologyFindings.finding: verifyEvidence checks the outer self-hash, fixed commit, raw metainfo, generated records, two generated-pickle bindings, and that all present controls say passed, but it does not recompute sourceManifestSha256 or bindingManifestSha256 and accepts an empty control list. verifyCertificate checks only the outer self-hash, schema, mandatoryGate.result, and one claim string; it does not rerun projections, full-population witness, controls, artifact pins, or conclusions.
counterexamples: A converter certificate with bindingManifestSha256 replaced, negativeControls emptied, and certificateSha256 recomputed was accepted by verifyEvidence.

A preflight certificate with fullReleasedPopulationProbe changed to pass, negativeControls emptied, a forged broad conclusion added, and certificateSha256 recomputed was accepted by verifyCertificate.
methodologyFindings.impactOnCurrentNarrowConclusion: none for the audited checked bytes, because the fresh builders reran the semantic paths and the preflight exact-hash-pins its source artifacts; blocks any claim that either exported verifier alone authenticates or semantically revalidates an arbitrary certificate

requiredFixes.fix: Make verifyEvidence enforce exact top-level and nested schemas, recompute sourceManifestSha256 and bindingManifestSha256, require the exact negative-control ID set and count, and reject missing controls. Bind or recheck runner and test bytes when verification is performed in-repository.

Make verifyCertificate validate both projections, recompute all manifests, rerun the mandatory gate, independently reconstruct the full 120-versus-90 witness, require the exact negative-control set, and check source-artifact pins and runner or test hashes. Do not treat a recomputable self-hash as authentication.

Have the gate consume verified projector receipts or rerun the pinned projectors from source artifacts. Do not infer independence only from object identity and caller-supplied provenance strings. Add a cloned-projection-with-forged-provenance negative control.

Persist cooperator-duplicate and ego-in-cohort failures on generated and released sides. Persist cooperator-order permutation as a positive metamorphic canonicalization control, because order is intentionally normalized rather than rejected.

requiredFixes.fix: Bind a content-addressed environment or dependency lock, including Python and package bytes, all imported execution code, effective parameters, and relevant assets. Retain the current shim and stub boundary until real PCD and PNG inputs are exercised.

requiredFixes.requiredFor: the residual novelty position in novelty audit v4
requiredFixes.fix: Add the complete event, temporal, ego-role, infrastructure-role, cohort, split, and population-filter ontology; bind container, assets, parameters, seeds, and nondeterminism policy; and install a non-bypassable verifier on every official train and eval entrypoint. Re-run a separate novelty audit after implementation.

verdict.summary: Fresh execution and independent recomputation support the exact bounded claim that the pinned mini released and actually generated vehicle-ego projections have the same 90 canonical keys and actual per-row cooperator sets, while the full released 120-row population fails by 30 ego-0 rows. Exact raw metainfo checking prevents the pinned alias from swallowing other changes. The exported gate and certificate verifiers have real adversarial weaknesses, but those weaknesses do not alter the current checked-byte conclusion because the audited CLI builders use exact-hash-pinned inputs and rerun both derivation paths. They do block stronger claims about standalone verification, unavoidable two-producer preflight, portable regeneration, or novelty.
